name: Hostinger
description: Hostinger sells web hosting, VPS and a website builder aimed at first-time site owners. Hosting plans are paid upfront for a multi-year term.
features: Premium, Unlimited, Cloud Startup and Agency Startup hosting plans
Free weekly or daily backups depending on plan
SSH, WP-CLI, staging and malware scanning on all plans
useCases: A first website or portfolio on your own domain
strengths: Free domain for 1 year and free mailboxes for 1 year on listed plans
limitations: Prices are tied to long terms (48 months on most plans) and renewal prices are higher
No free plan or trial is stated
